changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: For finance-led buyers who sell domestically, open with reconciliation in the buyer's words, not global growth: "Know where every deposit came from. Each payout reconciles automatically to its transactions and your ERP, so month-end stops being a week of archaeology." Lead the first call with the payout reconciliation demo, and offer to run it on the buyer's own data.
changes.why: The "Financial infrastructure, global growth, all the currencies" opener got silence from a business that sells "to restaurants in three states." The only reaction came from payout reconciliation, and the CFO's own words were "the deposits" and "I just want to know where my money is."

changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: For finance buyers, replace the third-party study with an offer to build their number: "Send us one month of your statements and we'll show you what reconciliation costs you today, in your numbers, not ours." Reuse the method only. Do not quote hours or dollar figures from other deals.
changes.why: The deal turned when a cost model was built from one month of the controller's statements and the CFO said "that's my number, not yours," after she had already asked to see it with their data.

changes.current_line: Built for developers: launch payments fast with our APIs, docs and sandbox.
changes.change: When the economic buyer is in finance and IT isn't building anything, stop leading proposals and first calls with APIs, docs and sandbox. Write page one for the finance decider in finance terms (close time, unmatched deposits), and move checkout and API detail to an appendix.
changes.why: The first proposal was "all about the portal. The checkout, the APIs." The deciding CFO read the first page and said it wasn't her problem, the deal stalled three weeks, and the IT team "aren't building anything."

changes.current_line: Trusted by leading businesses; see our customer stories.
changes.change: Add a wholesale/distributor reference (invoice-based business) that can take a peer call with a finance buyer. For distributor prospects, offer that reference instead of retail stories, and close the request before signature.
changes.why: The CFO asked to talk to another distributor and dismissed the retail story with "this is a company that sells sweaters." We never got her a call, and she brought it up twice.
